summary: Chemung Financial Corporation filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly dividend increase of $0.02 per share, raising the cash dividend to $0.36 per share, payable October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record September 17, 2026. The increase represents a 5.9% rise over the prior quarter and brings total increases since early 2025 to $0.05 per share, or 16.1%. No special situation is involved; this is an ordinary capital allocation event. No deal terms, advisors, or structural changes apply. What to watch: continued dividend growth as a sign of financial health, but no risk-arb angle.
